newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - April 3.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - April 3.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had two large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The first miss occured on Friday and the second occured on Monday.
Both misses were due to fewer reserves in the banking system, because Treasury deposits at the Fed were higher than anticipated.
The low in natural float occurred on Friday at about $25 million. The high in natural float was about $2.6 billion on Tuesday.
Transporation float averaged about $125 million per day with the high on Tuesday at about $700 million primarily due scattered weather delays in the Northeast.
